event.description: Reduce shared query-key width to 12 while retaining full values
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 2,128 parameters at 99.140000%, a +0.140000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family: attempt-0020 is the accepted projection-free attention result at 3,168 parameters and 99.94%, and there is no failed in-family result. The most recent experiment, attempt-0034 in parameter tying, peaked at 93.95% internal validation, closing LayerNorm bias sharing. Hypothesis: attention routing requires fewer features than the value/residual stream; reduce shared query and key width 16->12, retain the full 16D value stream and two heads, and save 128 parameters for a 2,000-parameter model. This is more informative than the nearest untested width 14 because a 25% routing-width reduction cleanly separates similarity capacity from value capacity while remaining conservative relative to halving query/key width to 8.
